content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

This is a self-hosted commerce stack designed for digital creators selling beats, plugins, or templates in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms are unavailable. It combines free and paid tools into a unified system: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for file delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic on-chain verification. The stack eliminates dependency on third-party platforms. You own the infrastructure. No one can shut it down. No geographic restrictions. No currency barriers. This is not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent architecture for sovereign commerce.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The frontend is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, processing orders and triggering file delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase (a free Postgres database) or Google Sheets. Files are delivered via Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain, firing a webhook to the backend the moment payment confirms. The system is stateless: no servers to manage, no databases to scale. It’s designed for low operational overhead. Transactions are priced in USD, converted to crypto at the time of payment. Recommended networks (BSC, Solana, TRON) keep fees under $0.10 per transaction. The entire stack is modular—swap components as needed without rebuilding from scratch.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and other regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. If you sell beats, courses, templates, fonts, or software and cannot collect payment through Stripe or PayPal, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent infrastructure. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform can delist you. No subscription fees. No revenue share. This is infrastructure sovereignty—not a workaround. It’s pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are the norm. If it works there, it works anywhere.
Own your commerce infrastructure—no platforms, no subscriptions, no geographic restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host the storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, processing orders and triggering file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data. Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive deliver the files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments, verifying transactions on-chain and firing a webhook to the backend. The stack is gluecode-free: each component integrates via APIs or webhooks. For example, NOWPayments’ webhook triggers the backend script, which queries the order database, retrieves the file, and sends the download link. The system is designed for low latency and high reliability. Files are delivered instantly. Payments are verified in real time. The entire stack is deployable in 48 hours.

If you prefer to build incrementally, deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Each stack is deployed in 48 hours, fully configured, with products loaded and tested. Alternatively, purchase The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for complete documentation and source code. Deploy on your own timeline. All stacks include 30-day support. This is not a course—it’s operational infrastructure. You’ll own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform dependencies. No subscriptions. Lifetime access. This is how you build sovereign commerce.

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages (free) or Cloudflare Pages (free). 2. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers (free tier) or Google Apps Script (free). 3. Configure order storage: Supabase (free tier) or Google Sheets. 4. Set up file delivery: Cloudflare R2 (pay-as-you-go) or Google Drive. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payments: sign up, configure API keys, and set up webhooks. 6. Deploy the storefront and test end-to-end: place a test order, verify payment, and confirm file delivery. 7. Load your products: upload beats, configure pricing in USD, and map to crypto networks (BSC, Solana, TRON for low fees). 8. Go live: share your store link with your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes pre-built templates and blueprints. Deploy in 48 hours with no coding required. All stacks include 30-day support.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, TRON—under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to host my beats files myself?
Yes. Use Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for file delivery. Both are pay-as-you-go and globally distributed.
Can customers pay in their local currency?
No. Prices are set in USD, converted to crypto at the time of payment. This eliminates currency volatility for you.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates on-chain—it cannot go down. If their API fails, the webhook retries until payment is verified.
